lines.trans: Chef, the festive dessert is already ready!
Attention everyone! The guest is tasting the newcomer's dish.
Come here, sweet little doggy! Taste the dessert.
She doesn't even look at the plate.
Chef, that is unfair! After all, it is a dog.
The world is not ideal at all, young man.
Let's make a bet, chef!
What will we bet about?
An ordinary person will like my hot dish.
Good! You will cook a dish for me.
If I like it, you stay here.
If not, you will leave here forever.
I agree to this bet!
We will see what kind of cook you are!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)

examples.trans: We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: Мы создадим идеальную команду для работы.
examples.trans: We will create an ideal team for work.

examples.text: Сегодня стояла идеальная погода для прогулки.
examples.trans: Today there was ideal weather for a walk.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
милый / милая used as a form of address
the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
as a predicate: так нечестно = that's not fair
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Да нет на него никакого компромата. Обычный мужик.
examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

meanings.en: to be liked, to make a good impression

examples.text: Синеозерск понравился в Москве больше других мест.
examples.trans: In Moscow they liked Sineozersk more than other places.

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

поспорить.gloss: to make a bet, wager, argue

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.text: Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Grab the little dog in the park and run.
What a funny little white dog!

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)

examples.trans: This is a bet, wager, dispute.
That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: У нас есть большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: We have a big platter of fish and crabs.

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)
